name: Brew like a Barista: Espresso Brewing & Latte Art Workshop
description:
Ever wondered what it takes to pour a latte art design worth showing off? This one’s for you.  
Our in-house trainers will guide you through the fundamentals of espresso extraction, milk steaming, crema, and a couple of milk-based recipes before helping you craft your latte art.  
Whether you’re a beginner or ready to pour the perfect rosetta, this workshop is crafted for coffee lovers and budding baristas alike.


Date: 6th September 2026 [Sunday]    


Venue:   Blue Tokai Coffee Roasters | Oshiwara Training Center, Mumbai
Blue Tokai Coffee Roasters, AECS Layout, Bengaluru
 Blue Tokai Coffee Roasters, Panchsheel, Delhi


Timings:  11 - 1 AM 
Please note that the tickets for this event are non-refundable and you cannot transfer your ticket to a future event. To ensure a smooth start, the workshop will commence 15 minutes after the scheduled time.
